statement: Towers get perk bonus at level 5; party starter is AAB: level to 15 and pick two top bonuses and one bottom bonus.
Pulse Mage is single target; A trait gives 25% multi-hit chance and B trait pushes enemies back 5 pixels.
Pushback does not affect boss monsters.
Pulse Mage is solid early but becomes useless mid game; it is the first tower you replace.
Pulse Mage trait setup is AAB.
Fire Lobber is first AOE tower; A trait 15% chance to shoot two fireballs; B trait increases explosion radius 20%.
Fire Lobber is good early but you will zoom past it.
Fire Lobber trait setup is AAB.
Boulder Roller carries you from mid game to early late game; upgrading it through construction is a must.
Boulder Roller has low range and low hit cap; A trait boulders travel 30% further; B trait hits extra two mobs per upgrade.
Boulder Roller will easily get you to about 50 plus waves until late game.
Boulder Roller trait setup BAB; running three side by side decimates mobs.
Frozen Malone slows enemies and is used in late game; A trait 15% more slow; B trait adds 2 seconds of slow.
Multiple Frozen Malones do not stack since it is a unique debuff; run only one in front of your DPS.
Frozen Malone trait setup AB since you never level it past level 10.
Storm Caller has no AOE but insane single target damage; A trait +200% damage to mobs under 60% HP; B trait +20% crit chance to all towers.
Mid game Storm Caller uses AB traits.
Late game Storm Caller uses BBB to give all towers 60% crit chance.
Party Starter is used absolutely everywhere from mid to late game and you use many of them.
Party Starter A trait gives towers in range 25% speed; B trait gives all towers 15% damage.
Pushing usually uses about 5 to 7 party starters.
Example: five party starters AAB and two BBA for a split between damage and speed.
Kraken summons underlings that push back enemies and keep them from progressing; A trait +1 max underling; B trait increases pushback.
Kraken is meta for late game progression and used in every composition.
Kraken keeps mobs condensed to concentrate DPS and pushes them into Frozen Malone to keep them slowed.
Kraken trait combo AAB or ABB depending on map and desired pushback; usually only level to 10.
Poison tower has ticking damage and no AOE cap so it hits every mob in a condensed area.
A trait increases poison cloud duration by 5 seconds; B trait increases tick damage by 30%.
Poison tower combo is ABB for maximum damage.
Poison tower will replace Boulder Rollers altogether.
Voidinator is new in World 5; weak small ranged AOE that debuffs mobs and permanently removes their buffs.
You need Voidinator to push high TD because blue mobs cause soft locking.
Voidinator A trait 25% chance for faster cooldown; B trait gives all towers 20% damage.
Level Voidinator only to 10 as it is expensive; run BB since party starters provide speed.
Early-mid boulder roller setup: one Frozen Malone then three Boulder Rollers; one Kraken; two Storm Callers in range; about five party starters.
Level order: all towers to 5 starting with party starters then boulder rollers; then party starters and boulder rollers to 10; party starters to 15.
With extra points or for a boss wave take Storm Callers to level 10 to squeeze an extra wave.
Late setup: Voidinator in front then Frozen Malone; four poison towers; one Storm Caller for crit chance; five to seven party starters.
Party starters are the main priority and bread and butter for damage.
Get every tower to level 5 ASAP starting with party starters then other towers to 15 though you likely won't reach it.
Gray is baseline; green heals below 50% HP; red applies healing buff on death; blue goes invincible after five hits.
Orange mobs are the biggest pain and destroy nearby towers once destroyed; purple mobs teleport each time hit.
Voidinator turns every mob into a gray mob which is why it is overpowered.
Hunter is the best class for tower defense.
Stop Right There roots all enemies in range for a duration scaling with talent level; it is the panic button.
Kung Fu Kick knocks back enemies further with higher talent level; useful for splitting boss mobs.
Hunter is pretty much required for high level TD; level those two talents and do TD with Hunter.
Farm toward the achievement Fat Souls which increases worship points by 15.
Salt Lick buff Dioxide Synthesis increases points earned from killing monsters in Tower Defense.
Stamp banked points increases starting points per level.
Vile crab juice gives points per level in cooking.
Meal canoli gives percentage bonus to points earned from killing mobs.
Farm Dun Souls and Rooted Souls cards for starting worship points up to 50 max; 100 with card doublers.
